activeWork.name: Independently validate the post-v0.25 transition checkpoint
activeWork.objective: Independently audit the seven local commits after the published v0.25.2 closure, report any blockers, and confirm whether the checkpoint is safe to push before further v0.26 implementation.

decisions.statement: Close v0.25.2 against the latest authoritative CI and installation results while retaining all historical validation evidence
Release readiness is computed from authoritative required gate evidence while every historical validation record remains immutable audit history.

AutoForge's ultimate north-star is a trusted, persistent, provider-neutral AI operator delivered through deterministic Core and independently gated Agent, Provider, Connector, Service, Web, memory, and intelligence layers.
AutoForge's official product tagline is: Human intent. AI execution. One shared understanding.
The v0.25 platform migration feature and all seven parent phases are completed

validation.summary: The approved release record confirms Protocol 0.1.0, Core 0.1.1, SDK 0.1.1, and Core CLI 0.25.2 are public with matching GitHub release, registry-install verification, and remote Linux and Windows CI.
The source-built CLI reports ready=true with 266 historical records, 37 preserved historical failures, 56 effective results, and zero effective required failures.
AutoForge doctor passes and the v0.25 feature, all seven phases, and all 22 child tasks report completed.
The latest scoped gate passed installation, file access, secret scan, typecheck, format, and tests for the official product-tagline documentation change.
The built @cojacklabs/autoforge-protocol agentHandoffSchema accepts this complete payload.
AutoForge gate check passed installation, containment, secret scanning, structured syntax, typecheck, format, and tests for this handoff and the updated work registry.
Remote CI for the seven local commits cannot run until explicit approval to push; the next agent must independently validate the commit range first.

risks: The seven commits after origin/main are local only, so no remote CI result exists for the combined checkpoint.

The globally installed 0.25.2 CLI predates superseding-evidence semantics and therefore reports historical failures as current blockers; validate the new behavior through the source-built CLI until a later release contains it.
The orchestration plan still projects two already-completed issues as ready, so orchestration state may require a separate reconciliation before it is used to assign v0.26 work.
The experimental Agent and Providers remain independently gated on generated-content safety and native credential-store validation; they were not approved by the Core v0.25.2 release.
openQuestions: Does an independent review find any correctness, security, documentation, or release-history blocker in origin/main..HEAD?
Should stale completed nodes in the current orchestration plan be reconciled before the next v0.26 implementation assignment?
nextAction: Run the documented AutoForge startup sequence, inspect this handoff and origin/main..HEAD, execute proportional source and package validation without editing or pushing, and report findings against issue.independently-validate-the-post-v0-25-transition-checkpoint.
